title: About
name: Ashlee Alaniz
paragraphs: I’m a technical artist and 3D generalist working in lighting, shading, environment art, and tool development.
I’m self-taught, with a background in additive manufacturing and software engineering. My practice includes procedural workflows and artist tools.
I’ve worked on projects for Warner Brothers/DC, Honkai: Star Rail, and Nike.
toolkit: Blender / Geometry Nodes / Substance Designer / Unity Shader Graph & VFX Graph / Unreal Blueprints
availability: Open to freelance, tutoring, and mentorship
